note: ADR-D02's draft command rows: operations of the Jumble and research surfaces that the command table does not hold yet, each with the request (section 15) that asks the top integrator for it, or, for the research pane's own rows, the build step whose row request it is (B28, B29). The shell registers them with D02 on, and the research pane's rows whenever the pane is mounted (ResearchRows.AddDrafts). A row is deleted from this file the day the command table gains its id (D02DraftRowsAbsentFromTable). No key is bound here; the palette can bind each one.

commands.label: Cap map: set threshold
commands.note: Sets the cap map's threshold, a set of predicates written as formulas (N_c ≥ k, N_c ≤ k, N_c = F_c), drawn as the Query set outline with members, non-members and blocked caps counted apart; no default threshold and no sort (ADR-D02.15). Argument: the formulas.

commands.label: Cap map: clear threshold
commands.note: Clears the cap map's threshold (ADR-D02.15).

commands.label: Name a cap
commands.note: Names a cap: its 80 meeting caps show in their static form, and its jobs may start; no job starts before a cap is named (ADR-D02.16, ADR-D02.19). Argument: the cap id.

commands.label: Un-name the cap
commands.note: Un-names the named cap; Local returns to its empty state (ADR-D02.12, ADR-D02.16).

commands.label: Cut slice: hold the split
commands.note: While held, splits the slice's layers into two linked copies with the same rotation, scale and shell (ADR-D02.17).

commands.label: Cut slice: set the radius shell
commands.note: Sets the slice's radius shell about the named cap's pole (ADR-D02.17). Argument: the shell.

commands.label: Raw view
commands.note: Local's cap-centred stereographic mode (ADR-D02.18).

commands.label: Raw view: set the clip
commands.note: Sets the raw view's clip, a half-space parallel to the cut's hyperplane, no further than 90 degrees; the default is exactly the named cap's cut (ADR-D02.18). Argument: h.

commands.label: Raw view: antipode chart beside
commands.note: Adds or removes the antipode chart side by side, sharing the clip and the handedness (ADR-D02.18).

commands.label: Jumble entry slot
commands.note: The entry slot keyed to the mode: Jumble on applies it, Jumble off reverts what it set that the researcher has not changed since; chrome only (ADR-D02.11, ADR-D02.12).

commands.label: Global chart: ring sheet
commands.note: The 20 Hopf rings as 20 rows of 30 rigid cell charts; the default chart (ADR-D02.9). Waits for R5's admission and its gate row before it ships.

commands.label: Global chart: Hopf rings
commands.note: 20 circles of 30 cells around a dodecahedron's vertices, turning with the camera (ADR-D02.9). Waits for R5's admission and its gate row before it ships.

commands.label: Focus: the named cap's straddlers
commands.note: The highlight-and-dim focus layer of the named blocked cap's straddlers; never a default, dims only at a blocked cap and never the cap map (ADR-D02.30).

commands.label: Repair list: focus a row's step
commands.note: Draws one step's moving set of the focused repair row, labelled "Repair k of m" (ADR-D02.34). Argument: the row and the step.

commands.label: Tint mode
commands.note: Switches the one per-pose tint channel: none, contact class, height or off-lattice; modes are never stacked (ADR-D02.20). Argument: the mode.

commands.label: Focus: one alignment domain
commands.note: One domain at full colour, the others dimmed, with a count (ADR-D02.21). Argument: the domain id.

commands.label: Focus: height at least k
commands.note: The pieces of height at least k, with their count (ADR-D02.23). Argument: k.

commands.label: ν-corrections: mark into the set
commands.note: Marks a ν-correction into the set with a signed multiplicity, for one chord to check the set (ADR-D02.39). Argument: the id and the multiplicity.

commands.label: Stage a repair row
commands.note: Stages a picked repair row as a sealed, whole-only fresh preview that writes the repair-pair record. The solver picks the row; the program never picks, orders or stages one by itself (ADR-D02.33). Argument: the row.

commands.label: Tuning: open the panel
commands.note: Opens the tuning panel as a tab in the current layout's right dock, beside History in Solve, so the views being judged stay visible (ADR-D02.47).

commands.label: Tuning: save preset
commands.note: Saves the tuning as a preset after the Save checks pass; a shipped preset is forked on edit (ADR-D02.47). Argument: the name.

commands.label: Tuning: apply preset
commands.note: Applies a tuning preset (ADR-D02.47). Argument: the preset.

commands.label: Tuning: set compare slot
commands.note: Stores the current tuning in one of the two tuning slots (ADR-D02.47). Argument: A or B.

commands.label: Tuning: swap compare slots
commands.note: Swaps the two tuning slots (ADR-D02.47).

commands.label: Tuning: hold to compare
commands.note: While held, shows the other tuning slot (ADR-D02.47).

commands.label: Tuning: hold a simulation
commands.note: While held, runs a colour-vision or high-contrast simulation; until a core simulation stage exists it covers the chrome only and says so (ADR-D02.47). Argument: protan, deutan, tritan or contrast.

commands.label: Tuning: revert the live selector
commands.note: Reverts the live selector's change (ADR-D02.47).

commands.label: Tuning: export a difference file
commands.note: Exports the tuning's difference from its preset as a file (ADR-D02.47).

commands.label: Research: step the checker
commands.note: Opens a check report's per-claim trace in LP4's debugger pane (ADR-D02.45).

commands.label: Research: open derived state in a free view
commands.note: Opens a run's derived state in a free view with its own binding source, captioned "derived; reachability open"; refused past the four-view envelope (ADR-D02.45).

commands.label: Read research record
commands.note: Reads a research record's one-paragraph finding and its tree of named parts with their lengths (ADR-D02.44, ADR-D02.49), and opens it in place in the research pane. Argument: the record.

commands.label: Declare research run
commands.note: Declares one field of the next research run before it starts (ADR-D02.4, ADR-D02.52): seed=<7401 to 7499> (its words name the scored block), depth=<twists> or budget=<steps>. A seed outside the pool is refused.

commands.label: Start research run
commands.note: Starts the declared research run (ADR-D02.4, ADR-D02.50): refused until its budget, seed and depth are declared. The run records its budget; a run that reaches it stops as cut off, never a verdict. It commits nothing, so History shows no research run.

commands.label: Hold a seat key
commands.note: While held, shows the seat's 12 twist keys with their rotation orders. With CR-19, a held seat key with a twist key routes as one chord (ADR-D02.42). Argument: the seat, 1 to 4.
